## Overview
A made-up guide that exercises every part of the Guide Import format.
- Two-handed Arms build with [Mortal Strike] at 40
- Keep [Battle Shout] up and use [Rend] on longer fights
More: https://example.com/warrior-guide/notes

## Talents
10-12: Improved Heroic Strike 3/3 -- Cheaper rage dump while leveling
13-17: Deflection 5/5
18-20: Improved Rend 3/3
21-22: Improved Charge 2/2 -- More rage on the pull
23-25: Improved Tactical Mastery 3/3
26-28: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 3/3
29: Anger Management 1/1
30-32: Deep Wounds 3/3
33-34: Impale 2/2
35-39: Weaponmaster 5/5
40: Mortal Strike 1/1 -- The core of the build
41: Sweeping Strikes 1/1
42-46: Cruelty 5/5
47-51: Unbridled Wrath 5/5
52-53: Improved Overpower 2/2
54-58: Iron Will 5/5
59-60: Improved Hamstring 2/3 | Improved Thunder Clap 2/3

## Rotation
Keep [Battle Shout] up.
@ 1-9
1. [Charge], then [Heroic Strike] when rage allows
@ 10-29
1. [Charge], [Rend]
2. [Overpower] when it lights up
3. [Heroic Strike] with spare rage
@ 30+
1. [Charge], [Rend], [Mortal Strike] on cooldown
2. [Execute] below 20%
@ AoE
1. [Thunder Clap], then [Sweeping Strikes] and [Cleave]

## Gear
Strength first, then crit. A slow two-hander such as [item:Whirlwind Axe] when you can get it.

## Tips
1. Macro for a quick charge: `/cast [target=NAME] Charge`
2. Eat between pulls; Well Fed adds experience.
